caption: Do not forget to follow me for more toddler-friendly snacks recipes  🎃 Healthy Halloween Pumpkin Muffins for Toddlers 👶 Looking for a fun Halloween snack that’s both spooky and healthy? These muffins are naturally sweetened with dates, packed with pumpkin and oats, and decorated in 3 playful ways toddlers can’t resist: spiders, witch hats, and monster eyes. ✨ Ingredients 1/2 cup (150g) pumpkin purée 1/3 cup (100g) unsweetened applesauce 1/3 cup (80g) dates (soaked in hot water, blended) 1 egg 1/4 cup (25g) walnuts, finely chopped 1 cup (100g) oat flour (blended oats) 1/4 tsp cinnamon 3/4cup (170g) buttermilk ✨ Instructions 1. Blend soaked dates until smooth. 2. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. 3. Divide into muffin molds and bake at 180°C for ~20 minutes. 4. Once cooled, top with Greek yogurt. 5. Decorate: make spiders with date sticks, witch hats, or monster eyes for a spooky Halloween twist. 💡 Why mums love them: No refined sugar → sweetened with fruit only 🍎 Packed with fiber → pumpkin + oats support digestion 🌱 Fun Halloween snack → festive and toddler-approved 🎃 Quick & freezer-friendly → perfect for busy mums ⏰ #healthyhalloween #healthysnacksideas #halloweensnack #toddlersnacks #sugarfreesnacks
